info.title: Classroom OS Web Alpha API
info.description: PR-01 normative design contract; not implemented service. All private reads no-store. Every write requires CSRF + idempotency. Product parameters and security POC gates remain in ADR/TBD register.

get.description: Resource ownership, tombstones and active account checked on the server. See 04-CONTRACTS-FLOWS.md for transaction semantics.

default.description: Typed failure; no private content in error messages.

get.description: Creates/refreshes random preauth-session cookie and bound CSRF token; same-origin no-store; Origin/Fetch-Metadata checked. Authenticated callers obtain token bound to current session. Secret-bearing response is never stored in operation_receipts. Recheck identity, authorization, epochs and expiry before reissuing; never replay old key/cookie/ticket.
